name: Ineffa
description: The benevolent half of the late Eleventh Dragon Lord, created and cared for by Aino in Nod-Krai. Introduced in Version 5.8 as a shield-support character who pioneers the Lunar-Charged reaction, a variant of Electro-Charged. Note: unlike the rest of this batch, Ineffa is associated with Nod-Krai, not Natlan.
